list.description: Include models served from local/non-vendor infra (conf/providers local: true, synced to llm_gateway.model_registry)

panels.title: Score Cards (hover for decomposition)
panels.description: The Overall Score as flat cards: score headline, verdict-colored accent (good >= 70, mixed 40-69, poor < 40), PAI and request count underneath. Hover a card for the full scorecard row: each rate with its index, PAI, friction context. Rendered by the Business Text panel (grafana/business-text, Apache-2.0, preinstalled via GF_PLUGINS_PREINSTALL -- bare IDs only, the env var has no version-pin syntax) from the same score-family query as p40/p41 -- one query, no hub or synthetic edges. Template HTML passes Grafana's DOMPurify sanitizer; disable_sanitize_html remains false. Same >=30-request gate and Local models toggle. Behavioral heuristic built from your reactions, not a benchmark.

options.content:
How to read this dashboard
Each card is one model. Overall is a 0-100 score built from your own reactions, and only models with 30+ requests are scored.
  • PAI (Prompt Adherence Index): your follow-up rejections, sessions you abandoned, and cancels.
  • Reliability: provider aborts.
Overall = 100 * sqrt(PAI * Reliability), so a weak factor cannot be hidden by a strong one. Bands: 70+ good, 40-69 mixed, below 40 poor. Hover a card for the full breakdown; the panels below cover session depth, friction, and the exact rejection and guard reasons. This is a behavioural heuristic, not a benchmark.

panels.title: Overall Score (adherence x reliability, geometric)
panels.description: Overall = sqrt(Adherence x Reliability), multiplied geometrically so one good factor cannot buy back a bad one. Adherence combines three rates measured on your own follow-up messages: follow-up rejection (goalpost 50%), switching away mid-session (100%) and client cancels (5%); Reliability covers provider aborts (5%). A measured factor that hits its goalpost floors at 0.05 instead of zeroing the whole score; a factor with no data counts neutral (0.5). Local models (llamafile etc.) can be hidden with the Local models toggle. Based on >= 30 requests per model. This is a behavioral heuristic built from your reactions, not a benchmark.

panels.title: Session Depth by Model (avg messages/session)
panels.description: Average conversation turns per session, per model. Deeper sessions usually mean you kept working with the model instead of giving up on it, so this is a soft acceptance proxy. Migrated history is included (one row per assistant generation).

panels.title: Friction Rate (per 100 requests, per day, stacked)
panels.description: How often tool actions hit friction, per 100 requests: guard-blocked commands, tool calls you rejected by hand, and calls denied by your own rules. Rates are daily and volume-weighted (a day's friction events divided by that day's requests), stacked by class so the stack top is your total friction per 100 requests and the bands show which kind dominates. Days with under 5 requests are hidden. These counts are a lower bound: a rejection can end a turn without producing another logged request.

panels.title: Top User Rejection Strings (censored)
panels.description: The exact words that fired rejection detection, ranked by how often they occurred. Profanity is censored to first/last letter; frustration phrases are shown as written. Every occurrence counts, so one ranting session can dominate a term.

panels.title: Top Guard Rules (ranked by blocked occurrences)
panels.description: Which shell-guard rules fire most often, extracted from BLOCKED markers in stored conversations. If a rule you actually need keeps appearing here, consider narrowing it. Models with under 100 responses are excluded.
